# NEW 2026-11-19 v6.4 N2 phase 1, the Turkish emirates (Umur's era). Generated by gen_beyliks.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# 2026-11-19 v6.6 N2 phase 2 (the sultan's eastern campaign and Timur's grace: events 4-6, worker codes 1 4 7, world steps W-5 to W-9a) added to this file by the same generator.
# 2026-11-19 v6.6 N2 phase 3 (rebuilding and the end: event 7, worker code 5, world steps W-9b and W-10) added to this file by the same generator.

# BYZ scope, monthly. Called by the main-line scheduler (gen_mainline_lock.py, LINES, id 18); this line writes no
# monthly hook of its own. Order (design 3.3): close in 1446.1.1, bookkeeping, world steps, then at most one event in a
# free month: .6 (Timur's grace) needs no calm, the others a calm month.
oe_bey_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_off } }
        if = { limit = { current_date >= 1446.1.1 } set_variable = oe_bey_off }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_bey_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
            oe_bey_book = yes
            oe_bey_world = yes
            if = {
                limit = { oe_ml_free = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 0 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 0 oe_bey_ok_6 = yes } random = { chance = oe_bey_ch_6 set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 6 } } }
                if = {
                    limit = { oe_bey_calm = yes }
                    if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 0 oe_bey_ok_2 = yes } random = { chance = oe_bey_ch_2 set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 2 } } }
                    if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 0 oe_bey_ok_4 = yes } random = { chance = 15 set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 4 } } }
                    if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 0 oe_bey_ok_5 = yes } random = { chance = 25 set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 5 } } }
                    if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 0 oe_bey_ok_7 = yes } random = { chance = oe_bey_ch_7 set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 7 } } }
                    if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 0 oe_bey_ok_3 = yes } random = { chance = 20 set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 3 } } }
                    if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 0 oe_bey_ok_1 = yes } random = { chance = 15 set_variable = { name = oe_bey_pick value = 1 } } }
                }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 6 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_6 value = 1 } oe_bey_fire = { n = 6 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_2 value = 1 } oe_bey_fire = { n = 2 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 4 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_4 value = 1 } oe_bey_fire = { n = 4 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 5 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_5 value = 1 } oe_bey_fire = { n = 5 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 7 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_7 value = 1 } oe_bey_fire = { n = 7 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_3 value = 1 } oe_bey_fire = { n = 3 } }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_pick = 1 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_1 value = 1 } oe_bey_fire = { n = 1 } }
                remove_variable = oe_bey_pick
            }
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. Sends an event of the monthly check (it is marked fired just before, above).
oe_bey_fire = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_bey_st value = $n$ }
    trigger_event_non_silently = oe_bey.$n$
}

# BYZ scope, monthly. Bookkeeping, no pop-ups (design 3.3): Umur's death, the strong route, the chronicle's void, the
# capture of the sultan and the months since W-9a (phase 2), and the windows that passed.
oe_bey_book = {
    # Umur first seen dead (any cause): .2 may come in the next 6 months.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_umur_dead } NOT = { character:ayd_umur ?= { is_alive = yes } } }
        set_variable = oe_bey_umur_dead
        set_variable = { name = oe_bey_umur_m value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_bey: Umur is dead (W-1 [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_world_a')|0])"
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_bey_umur_m } change_variable = { name = oe_bey_umur_m add = 1 } }
    # The strong route ended the contest of the Roman world: the Ottoman part of this line is void (decision 3).
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_void } international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world ?= { has_variable = oe_rw_contest_ended } }
        set_variable = oe_bey_void
    }
    # The chronicle's void: before 1348 none of the five western emirates is left (design 4.4).
    if = {
        limit = {
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_gone }
            current_date < 1348.1.1
            NOT = { country_exists = c:AYD }
            NOT = { country_exists = c:SRU }
            NOT = { country_exists = c:GRM }
            NOT = { country_exists = c:KAR }
            NOT = { country_exists = c:MEN }
        }
        set_variable = oe_bey_gone
    }
    # Phase 2. Timur holds the sultan (B3), first seen now: W-9a may run in this and the next 18 months.
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_cap_m } oe_bey_cap_seen = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_bey_cap_m value = 0 }
        debug_log = "oe_bey: Timur holds the sultan; W-9a may run"
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_bey_cap_m } change_variable = { name = oe_bey_cap_m add = 1 } }
    # Phase 2. Months since W-9a released the emirates (it sets 0 in its own month): .6 comes within 6.
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_bey_grace_m } change_variable = { name = oe_bey_grace_m add = 1 } }
    # Windows that passed without their event.
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_1 } var:oe_bey_m > 46 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_1 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_2 } OR = { var:oe_bey_m > 348 AND = { has_variable = oe_bey_umur_m var:oe_bey_umur_m > 6 } } } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_2 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_3 } var:oe_bey_m > 348 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_3 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_4 } var:oe_bey_m > 756 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_4 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_5 } var:oe_bey_m > 780 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_5 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_6 } OR = { var:oe_bey_m > 912 AND = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_w9 global_var:oe_bey_w9 = 2 } AND = { has_variable = oe_bey_grace_m var:oe_bey_grace_m > 6 } } } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_6 value = 2 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_done_7 } var:oe_bey_m > 1294 } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_done_7 value = 2 } }
}

# BYZ scope. W-1: Umur falls before the harbour castle of Smyrna (spring 1348); the heir succeeds by itself.
oe_bey_w1_do = {
    kill_character = { target = character:ayd_umur reason = siege location = location:smyrna }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-1: Umur falls before the harbour castle of Smyrna"
}
# BYZ scope. W-2: Khidr's peace with the Latins (August 1348): half the port dues to the Latins, the fleet laid up.
oe_bey_w2_do = {
    c:AYD = { add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_latin_customs years = 15 mode = replace } }
    c:VEN ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_latin_peace target = c:AYD } } }
    c:KNI ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_latin_peace target = c:AYD } } }
    c:CYP ?= { if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_latin_peace target = c:AYD } } }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-2: Khidr's peace with the Latins"
}
# BYZ scope. W-3: Menteshe's new treaty with Venice (Crete); Venetian merchants back at Balat (1337).
oe_bey_w3_do = {
    location:balat = { add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_balat_trade years = 10 mode = replace } }
    c:MEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_balat target = c:VEN } }
    c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_balat target = c:MEN } }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-3: the Venetians at Balat"
}
# BYZ scope. W-4: Germiyan takes in its vassal Sahib Ata (1341), a peaceful transfer.
oe_bey_w4_do = {
    c:GRM = { annex_country = { country = c:SHP reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-4: Sahib Ata joins Germiyan"
}
# ---- phase 2
# BYZ scope. W-5: the dowry of Germiyan (1381): of Kütahya, Simav, Emet and Tavşanlı, those Germiyan holds pass to the
# Ottomans in peace. Germiyan's seat (Kütahya at the start) moves first to its most populous place outside the dowry.
oe_bey_w5_do = {
    c:GRM = {
        if = {
            limit = { OR = { capital = location:kutahya capital = location:simav capital = location:emet capital = location:tavsanli } }
            ordered_owned_location = {
                limit = { NOT = { this = location:kutahya } NOT = { this = location:simav } NOT = { this = location:emet } NOT = { this = location:tavsanli } }
                order_by = population
                save_scope_as = oe_bey_seat
            }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_bey_seat } set_capital = scope:oe_bey_seat }
        }
    }
    location:kutahya = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GRM } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:simav = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GRM } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:emet = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GRM } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    location:tavsanli = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:GRM } change_location_owner = c:TUR } }
    c:GRM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_dowry target = c:TUR } }
    c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_bw_dowry target = c:GRM } }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-5: the dowry of Germiyan"
}
# Country scope (an emirate). It becomes the sultan's vassal: not annexed, so Timur can set it free again (W-9a).
oe_bey_submit = {
    make_subject_of = { target = c:TUR type = subject_type:vassal }
    set_variable = { name = oe_bey_sub value = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. W-6: the sultan's eastern campaign (1390): Aydin, Saruhan, Menteshe and Germiyan, each if it can be brought
# under (oe_bey_can_submit).
oe_bey_w6_do = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { oe_bey_sub_go = yes } } c:AYD = { oe_bey_submit = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SRU c:SRU = { oe_bey_sub_go = yes } } c:SRU = { oe_bey_submit = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MEN c:MEN = { oe_bey_sub_go = yes } } c:MEN = { oe_bey_submit = yes } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GRM c:GRM = { oe_bey_sub_go = yes } } c:GRM = { oe_bey_submit = yes } }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-6: the sultan's eastern campaign"
}
# BYZ scope. W-7: Kastamonu (1391).
oe_bey_w7_do = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CND c:CND = { oe_bey_sub_go = yes } } c:CND = { oe_bey_submit = yes } }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-7: Kastamonu submits"
}
# BYZ scope. W-8: Akçay (1397 or 1398): Karaman. If the empire paid Karaman in .5 a, the sultan remembers it.
oe_bey_w8_do = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KAR c:KAR = { oe_bey_sub_go_kar = yes } } c:KAR = { oe_bey_submit = yes } }
    if = {
        limit = {
            has_global_variable = oe_bey_kar_strike
            global_var:oe_bey_kar_strike = 1
            country_exists = c:KAR
            c:KAR = { has_variable = oe_bey_sub is_subject_of = c:TUR }
        }
        c:TUR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_kar_plot target = c:BYZ } }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-8: Karaman after Akcay"
}
# BYZ scope. W-9a: Timur's grace (1402). Each of the six emirates that is an AI vassal of the Ottomans is released, with
# a ten-year truce both ways; oe_bey_back = 1 on it, the count in the global oe_bey_restored_n. Timur's own vassals are
# not the sultan's and so are left alone. Annexed emirates are phase 3's W-9b.
oe_bey_w9_do = {
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_restored_n value = 0 }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { is_ai = yes is_subject_of = c:TUR } }
        c:TUR = { cancel_subject = c:AYD }
        c:AYD = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_back value = 1 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_restored_n add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:SRU c:SRU = { is_ai = yes is_subject_of = c:TUR } }
        c:TUR = { cancel_subject = c:SRU }
        c:SRU = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_back value = 1 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_restored_n add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:MEN c:MEN = { is_ai = yes is_subject_of = c:TUR } }
        c:TUR = { cancel_subject = c:MEN }
        c:MEN = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_back value = 1 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_restored_n add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:GRM c:GRM = { is_ai = yes is_subject_of = c:TUR } }
        c:TUR = { cancel_subject = c:GRM }
        c:GRM = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_back value = 1 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_restored_n add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:KAR c:KAR = { is_ai = yes is_subject_of = c:TUR } }
        c:TUR = { cancel_subject = c:KAR }
        c:KAR = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_back value = 1 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_restored_n add = 1 }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:CND c:CND = { is_ai = yes is_subject_of = c:TUR } }
        c:TUR = { cancel_subject = c:CND }
        c:CND = { add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_back value = 1 } }
        change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_restored_n add = 1 }
    }
    set_variable = { name = oe_bey_grace_m value = 0 }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-9a: Timur's grace, emirates released [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_restored')|0]"
}
# ---- phase 3
# BYZ scope. W-9b: the emirates rebuilt (1402). Each of the six that is gone, with at least 3 of its 1337 home
# places in AI Ottoman or Timurid hands, is built again from cores on those places; then every restored emirate (W-9a's
# and W-9b's: oe_bey_back) gets back its home places in those hands (Germiyan's dowry among them, decision 208).
# Globals: oe_bey_rebuilt (a digit for each emirate: 1 rebuilt, 2 and 3 the two failures) and oe_bey_home_n (places
# handed back). A rebuilt emirate counts in oe_bey_restored_n and opens .6 as W-9a does.
oe_bey_w9b_do = {
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_bey_restored_n } } set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_restored_n value = 0 } }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_rebuilt value = 0 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n value = 0 }
    oe_bey_rebuild_ayd = yes
    oe_bey_rebuild_sru = yes
    oe_bey_rebuild_men = yes
    oe_bey_rebuild_grm = yes
    oe_bey_rebuild_kar = yes
    oe_bey_rebuild_cnd = yes
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { is_ai = yes has_variable = oe_bey_back } } oe_bey_give_ayd = yes }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SRU c:SRU = { is_ai = yes has_variable = oe_bey_back } } oe_bey_give_sru = yes }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MEN c:MEN = { is_ai = yes has_variable = oe_bey_back } } oe_bey_give_men = yes }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GRM c:GRM = { is_ai = yes has_variable = oe_bey_back } } oe_bey_give_grm = yes }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KAR c:KAR = { is_ai = yes has_variable = oe_bey_back } } oe_bey_give_kar = yes }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CND c:CND = { is_ai = yes has_variable = oe_bey_back } } oe_bey_give_cnd = yes }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-9b: rebuilt [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_rebuilt')|0] (a digit for each emirate: 1 ok, 2 3 failed), home places handed back [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_home')|0], restored in all [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_restored')|0]"
}
# BYZ scope. One more emirate stands again through W-9b: it counts as restored, W-9 is done for .6 (which needs
# oe_bey_w9 = 1 and counts its months from W-9a, or from here when W-9a released nobody).
oe_bey_count_rebuilt = {
    change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_restored_n add = 1 }
    set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_w9 value = 1 }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_bey_grace_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_bey_grace_m value = 0 } }
}
# BYZ scope. W-9b: Musa's emirate (AYD, seat birgi, 8 home places) rebuilt: cores, then its home places handed over, the seat first (r20, probe 10).
oe_bey_rebuild_ayd = {
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { country_exists = c:AYD } oe_bey_home_n_ayd >= 3 }
        location:birgi = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } add_core = c:AYD } }
        location:smyrna = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } add_core = c:AYD } }
        location:ayasuluk = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } add_core = c:AYD } }
        location:cesme = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } add_core = c:AYD } }
        location:urla = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } add_core = c:AYD } }
        location:tire = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } add_core = c:AYD } }
        location:guzelhisar = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } add_core = c:AYD } }
        location:nazilli = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } add_core = c:AYD } }
        location:birgi = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:AYD change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:smyrna = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:AYD change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:ayasuluk = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:AYD change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:cesme = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:AYD change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:urla = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:AYD change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:tire = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:AYD change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:guzelhisar = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:AYD change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:nazilli = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:AYD change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { num_locations >= 2 } }
            c:AYD = {
                if = { limit = { location:birgi = { owner ?= c:AYD } NOT = { capital = location:birgi } } set_capital = location:birgi }
                # Musa
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { ruler ?= { dynasty = dynasty:aydinids_dynasty } } }
                    create_character = {
                        first_name = name_moses
                        female = no
                        age = 40
                        dynasty = dynasty:aydinids_dynasty
                        culture = culture:turkish_culture
                        religion = religion:sunni
                        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                        save_scope_as = oe_bey_lord_ayd
                    }
                    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_bey_lord_ayd } set_new_ruler = scope:oe_bey_lord_ayd }
                }
                add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_bey_back value = 2 }
            }
            oe_bey_count_rebuilt = yes
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_rebuilt add = 1 }
            debug_log = "oe_bey W-9b: AYD rebuilt from its cores"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:AYD }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_rebuilt add = 3 }
            debug_log = "oe_bey W-9b FAILED: AYD was built with fewer than 2 places; not counted as restored"
        }
        else = {
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_rebuilt add = 2 }
            debug_log = "oe_bey W-9b FAILED: the build left no AYD; not counted as restored"
        }
    }
}

        location:sarkikaraagac = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:seydisehir = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:ilgin = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:turgut = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:suluklu = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:kulu_turkey = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:obruk = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:altinekin = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:cumra = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:silifke = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:anamur = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:mut = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        location:nigde = { if = { limit = { oe_bey_held = yes } change_location_owner = c:KAR change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_home_n add = 1 } } }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:KAR c:KAR = { num_locations >= 2 } }
            c:KAR = {
                if = { limit = { location:konya = { owner ?= c:KAR } NOT = { capital = location:konya } } set_capital = location:konya }
                # Mehmed II
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { ruler ?= { dynasty = dynasty:karamanids_dynasty } } }
                    create_character = {
                        first_name = name_muhammad
                        female = no
                        age = 25
                        dynasty = dynasty:karamanids_dynasty
                        culture = culture:turkish_culture
                        religion = religion:sunni
                        estate = estate_type:nobles_estate
                        save_scope_as = oe_bey_lord_kar
                    }
                    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_bey_lord_kar } set_new_ruler = scope:oe_bey_lord_kar }
                }
                add_truce_with = { target = c:TUR years = 10 mutual = yes }
                set_variable = { name = oe_bey_back value = 2 }
            }
            oe_bey_count_rebuilt = yes
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_rebuilt add = 10000 }
            debug_log = "oe_bey W-9b: KAR rebuilt from its cores"
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:KAR }
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_rebuilt add = 30000 }
            debug_log = "oe_bey W-9b FAILED: KAR was built with fewer than 2 places; not counted as restored"
        }
        else = {
            change_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_rebuilt add = 20000 }
            debug_log = "oe_bey W-9b FAILED: the build left no KAR; not counted as restored"
        }
    }
}

# BYZ scope. W-10: Yakub's will (1429): Germiyan passes to the Ottomans in peace.
oe_bey_w10_do = {
    c:TUR = { annex_country = { country = c:GRM reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
    debug_log = "oe_bey W-10: Germiyan is left to the sultan"
}
# BYZ scope. .7 a / .7 b: Karaman strikes while the West marches (H31). Ankara, and with the compact brokered Kütahya
# too, are looted where an AI Ottoman state holds them.
oe_bey_strike = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_ai = yes } has_global_variable = oe_bey_kar_1443 }
        location:ankara = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } } }
        if = { limit = { global_var:oe_bey_kar_1443 = 2 } location:kutahya = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:TUR } add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace } } } }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_bey .7: Karaman strikes at the sultan's back"
}

# BYZ scope. Pay / gain $months$ months of trade and tax income.
oe_bey_pay = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = -$months$ } }
oe_bey_gain = { add_gold = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax multiply = $months$ } }
# Any scope. Imperial Authority of the Imperial Pillars changes by $amount$, kept within 0-100 (phase 2, .4 a).
oe_bey_auth = { international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars ?= { if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_pillars_authority } change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = $amount$ } clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 } } } }

# BYZ scope. The hidden worker oe_bey.90 (var:oe_bey_do): 2 the raid of .1 a, 3 the alliance broken in .2 b, 6 the
# watch on the Hellespont of .3 a; phase 2: 1 Philadelphia handed over (.4 a), 4 the restored emirates befriended
# (.6 a), 7 the restored emirates left cold (.6 b); phase 3: 5 Karaman strikes (.7 a and b).
oe_bey_do_job = {
    if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_do ?= 2 } oe_bey_raid = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_bey_do ?= 3 }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:AYD has_mutual_scripted_relation = { type = relation_type:alliance target = c:AYD } }
            remove_relation = { type = relation_type:alliance first = c:BYZ second = c:AYD }
        }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_do ?= 6 } oe_bey_watch = yes }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:oe_bey_do ?= 1 }
        if = {
            limit = { country_exists = c:TUR location:alasehir = { owner ?= c:BYZ } }
            location:alasehir = { change_location_owner = c:TUR }
            debug_log = "oe_bey .4 a: Philadelphia handed to the Ottomans"
        }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_do ?= 4 } oe_bey_befriend = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_do ?= 7 } oe_bey_cold = yes }
    else_if = { limit = { var:oe_bey_do ?= 5 } oe_bey_strike = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_bey_do
}
# BYZ scope. .6 a / .6 b: every emirate Timur restored (oe_bey_back) thinks better / worse of the empire.
oe_bey_befriend = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:AYD = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_counterweight target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SRU c:SRU = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:SRU = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_counterweight target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MEN c:MEN = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:MEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_counterweight target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GRM c:GRM = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:GRM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_counterweight target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KAR c:KAR = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:KAR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_counterweight target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CND c:CND = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:CND = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_counterweight target = c:BYZ } } }
}
oe_bey_cold = {
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:AYD c:AYD = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:AYD = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_cold target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SRU c:SRU = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:SRU = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_cold target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MEN c:MEN = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:MEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_cold target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:GRM c:GRM = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:GRM = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_cold target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:KAR c:KAR = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:KAR = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_cold target = c:BYZ } } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:CND c:CND = { has_variable = oe_bey_back } } c:CND = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_cold target = c:BYZ } } }
}
# BYZ scope. .1 a: back from the Black Sea with the loot; Kilia is sacked and its owner (and Wallachia) remember it.
# Only AI countries are hit (a player's Kilia or Wallachia is left alone).
oe_bey_raid = {
    oe_bey_gain = { months = 2 }
    location:chilia = {
        if = {
            limit = { owner ?= { is_ai = yes NOT = { tag = BYZ } } }
            add_location_modifier = { modifier = looted years = 3 mode = replace }
            owner = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_raided target = c:BYZ } }
        }
    }
    c:WAL ?= {
        if = {
            limit = { is_ai = yes NOT = { location:chilia = { owner ?= c:WAL } } }
            add_opinion = { modifier = oe_bey_b_raided target = c:BYZ }
        }
    }
    debug_log = "oe_bey .1 a: sailed with Umur into the Black Sea"
}
# BYZ scope. .3 a: the empire's places in the Dardanelles province gain the watch on the Hellespont for 20 years.
oe_bey_watch = {
    location:gallipoli = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
    location:enez = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
    location:hayrabolu = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
    location:malgara = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
    location:rodoscuk = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
    location:kesan = { if = { limit = { owner ?= c:BYZ } add_location_modifier = { modifier = oe_bey_hellespont_watch years = 20 mode = replace } } }
}

# BYZ scope. One debug_log line with the readouts (test page, observer logs).
oe_bey_log = { debug_log = "oe_bey cw=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_counterweight')|0] sea=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_blacksea')|0] umur=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_umur')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_umur_m')|0] strait=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_strait')|0] phil=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_phil')|0] kar=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_kar')|0] cap=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_cap_m')|0] back=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_restored')|0] grace=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_grace')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_grace_m')|0] done=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_done')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_done7')|0] world=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_world_a')|0]/[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_world_b')|0] rebuilt=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_rebuilt')|0] home=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_bey_rd_home')|0]" }

# opinions and location modifiers stay.

    remove_variable = oe_bey_grace_m

    remove_variable = oe_bey_dev_force

    remove_variable = oe_bey_done_2
    remove_variable = oe_bey_done_3
    remove_variable = oe_bey_done_4
    remove_variable = oe_bey_done_5
    remove_variable = oe_bey_done_6
    remove_variable = oe_bey_done_7
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_w1
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_w2
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_w3
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_w4
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_w5
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_w6

    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_restored_n
    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_kar_strike
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:AYD } c:AYD = { remove_variable = oe_bey_sub remove_variable = oe_bey_back } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:SRU } c:SRU = { remove_variable = oe_bey_sub remove_variable = oe_bey_back } }
    if = { limit = { country_exists = c:MEN } c:MEN = { remove_variable = oe_bey_sub remove_variable = oe_bey_back } }

    remove_global_variable = oe_bey_kar_1443
}

oe_bey_test_w9b = {
    if = { limit = { oe_bey_w9b_who = yes } oe_bey_w9b_do = yes set_global_variable = { name = oe_bey_w9b value = 1 } }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_bey test W-9b: nothing to rebuild or hand back (an emirate must be gone with 3 home places in AI Ottoman or Timurid hands, or restored with one)" }
}
# BYZ scope. Give W-9b something to rebuild: the Ottomans take Saruhan in peace (both AI). Not part of the line.
oe_bey_test_annex = {
    if = {
        limit = { country_exists = c:TUR c:TUR = { is_ai = yes } country_exists = c:SRU c:SRU = { is_ai = yes } }
        c:TUR = { annex_country = { country = c:SRU reason = Diplomatic transfer = yes } }
    }
    else = { debug_log = "oe_bey test: the Ottomans or Saruhan are not in place or not AI" }
}
